description: Free. Hands the owner-signed Mandate to the executor. Refused unless the signer is the manager's ownerOf(1), the signature is under 10 minutes old and new, the strategy still hashes to what was signed, and the executor is already the manager's operator. Returns the status and `telegram`: a t.me link the owner opens to get the executor's notes (acted, held a decision, stopped) — handed out only here. Then executor_topup — without credit the executor only observes.

message.description: The typed data's `message`, exactly as signed
